cards.note: Host-only settings plugin; it reaches configuration through the owning domain service (ctx.settings) and never used the removed Host APIProxy or ctx.remote (grep: 0 hits).
Writes no third-party persisted SessionEvents, and the target is alpha.2 (A2-01 restores the retention semantics), not alpha.1.
No dsh-side patch and no import from internal session-view paths; the plugin is one small host module.
Not a launcher wrapper/SDK integration: composition is declared with the official dsh.bundle.patch field and resolved by the launcher; the plugin never reads profile files or hardcodes a home.
No headless wrapper, process supervisor, or stdout/stderr parser in this repository.
No tool presentation mode, PTC preset, dispatch waterfall, or related type usage (grep: 0 hits).
No permission/approval/WebFetch policy or preset override; the bundle patch only inserts this plugin's own entry.
No custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC, browser page, or /api route; nothing to move behind the Connection auth gate.
Not a model-provider plugin and it claims no models-page sign-in seat (optional capability, not adopted).
No localization resources, locale dictionary, or i18n patch to replace (optional capability, not adopted).
No subagent orchestration or provider/model selector surface.
Informational/deployment-level privacy behaviour of the official DeepSeek adapter; the plugin neither uses the adapter nor ships a user-facing surface, so plugin code needs no change.
No persistent PowerShell/Bash or Windows directory-picker workaround exists to retire.
Does not enable session-log-deepseek and performs no session-log egress; the opt-in condition is not met.
No browser-half acceptance script or wrapper, and no hardcoded web root/bundle path/startup-log format; activation was checked with a host profile cold boot instead.
Registers no structured-question answerer (userQuestions.registerProvider is unused).
Does not infer agent presets from persisted sessions or set agent-presets roots.
Does not import isTokenDelta or any @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/message symbol.
Not a profile/bundle maintainer: the package ships a bundle patch that only inserts its own entry; it composes no dsh-base rows and states no telemetry stance.
No direct @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency or import, so no second pi-ai instance can appear.
No Web Client half and no @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime reference (inject-lint staged run: runtimeRefsLeft [], importedClientModules []).
No dsh.client manifest half or client bundle is built or mounted, so the entry/module/registration id contract does not apply.
Reads no session timeline, conversation node, or user message content; it only registers a settings namespace.
No composer DOM access or draft/history manipulation.
Renders no MarkdownText/CodeBlock and imports no @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives.
No browser half and no ctx.connection.api.* consumer.
Constructs no subagent seed/persisted descriptors and asserts no subagent/descriptor shape.
No ctx.workspaces / ctx.uiWorkspace navigation, directory, or snapshot-field usage.
Produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents, so the restored ignorable retention semantics need no producer-side action.
No ctx.remote unary calls, so there is no RemoteResult/RemoteError branch to handle.

The migration maintains this package's dependency graph: devDependencies now pin the whole alpha.2 closure exactly (cordis 4.0.2, schemastery 3.18.2, and dsh-settings/dsh-brand/dsh-invariants/dsh-session/dsh-scope/dsh-llm/dsh-timeout/dsh-typert-protocol/dsh-util-crypto/dsh-util-values all 0.1.2-alpha.2, the versions the alpha.2 host itself ships), so no `^` range can float to 0.1.2-rc.1 / cordis 4.0.4 / schemastery 3.18.4 and fail a release-date-bounded install; peerDependencies still name the host modules (cordis ^4.0.1, dsh-settings ^0.1.2-alpha.2, schemastery ^3.18.2); verified with an isolated `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and with the exact `npm install --no-save --before=2026-08-30T15:10:52.613Z <cohort>` pin the mechanical check runs; see pnpm-lock.yaml.
No startup wrapper or CI matrix forcing Node 22 / skipping dsh web, and no web half; verification ran on Node 24.21.0, outside the 24.0-24.11.1 failure window.
Does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
No client Remote usage, so $host.home / $host.isLoopback are not read.
Not a self-composed profile: the deployed profile uses the shipped dsh-base bundle (which mounts session-projection), and the bundle patch only inserts this one entry.

Namespace is now the lowercase literal 'h5-runtime-drift' checked by SettingsNamespaceInput; the removed runtime import is gone, the test double uses `as SettingsNamespace` (src/test/settings.test.ts), package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml sit on the alpha.2 cohort, and a clean rebuild plus packed-install boot verified live settings.describe()/get() on the alpha.2 host.
